We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (from make_6_lvl2-template_search-2) to the molecule given in make_6_lvl2-apply_template-1 input: that molecule SMILES is 'COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4=O)cc3)c2N)c1'.

We have template_id 1914393 and mapped_rxn. Need to apply template to target molecule to get precursors. Use apply_template tool with molecule_smiles and template_id.

Let's call apply_template.
